title: Girl with Scroll Machine
description: A girl with a long braid stands with her back to the viewer in a room covered in paint marks and writing. Her left hand touches a large mechanical wheel device that holds a long curling scroll filled with writing while her right hand holds an abacus.
prompt: a girl with a long braid seen from behind stands in a room with walls and floor covered in painted marks and writing. she touches a large dark mechanical wheel device that holds a long curling yellow scroll covered in writing. her other hand holds a wooden abacus. books a candle and ruler lie on the floor. purple blue and gold color palette.
